applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
Repayment uses the original borrowing account. Funds appearing on a related company account are not automatically swept. Active reservations on that account reduce repayment capacity. A posting correction can change where cash is available without changing the facility borrower.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-bridge`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
